description: Flood Defence Structures is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Natural Resources Wales. The National Flood Asset Database records flood infrastructure in Wales managed by Lead Local Flood Authorities (LLFAs) and Natural Resources Wales (NRW). It includes many embankments, walls, flood gates, culverts, and inlet screens (which catch debris), but not all flood infrastructure maintained or owned by these parties. Coverage: Natural Resources Wales. The portal files it under the publisher Natural Resources Wales. Its tags are Coastal Margins (SMNR), Ecosystem (SMNR), Flooding (SMNR), Hydrological Processes (SMNR), Management Areas (SMNR). The portal shows 2026-09-16 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
